message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) for the case. Facts: A public official (谢某某) working at the housing registration center (房产局房屋登记中心) accepted falsified documents and issued a property title (房产证) to a couple (谭2某夫妇) based on fake land certificates and planning permits. Then the couple used the property as collateral to get credit cards (准贷记卡) from a bank, and the fraudster (谢1某) got the money from the cards. The bank later discovered the documents were fake, the property registration was fraudulent. The official (谢某某) failed to verify documents, allowed fraudulent registration, causing loss to the bank and public interest. The official is charged with something like "滥用职权" (abuse of power) or "徇私舞弊" (abuse of official duties) or "玩忽职守" (negligent duty). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain) under Article 397? Actually Article 397: "国家工作人员徇私舞弊，致使国家、集体或者个人的财产、权益受到重大损失的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also "玩忽职守罪" (negligent duty) under Article 397? Actually Article 397 also covers "玩忽职守罪". The description: "国家工作人员玩忽职守，致使国家、集体或者个人的财产、权益受到重大损失的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the official's conduct: He knowingly accepted falsified documents and issued property title, facilitating fraud. That is "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). Also could be "受贿罪"? He was contacted by谢1某, but no mention of receiving bribe. He just gave favor. Might be "徇私舞弊罪". The question: "公诉机关认为，被告人谢某某对本职工作严重不负责任，不履行或不正确履行自己的工作职责，致使公共财产、国家和人民利益遭受重大损失，其行为已构成××". So likely "玩忽职守罪". Because they say "不履行或不正确履行自己的工作职责". That's typical language for "玩忽职守". So answer: [罪名]玩忽职守<eoa>
